title: Stochastic Model-Based Methods for Minimizing Paraconvex Functions
summary: This paper studies stochastic algorithms for minimizing paraconvex functions, a function class that generalizes weakly convex functions and includes, for instance, Hölder smooth functions and compositions of convex functions with Hölder smooth maps. We first establish the convergence of the stochastic subgradient method and the stochastic proximal subgradient method for unconstrained and composite paraconvex optimization, respectively.
